title: Superconductivity in High-Entropy Alloy System Containing Tb.

recollection.starting_material: High-entropy alloy system containing Tb (terbium) and other elements.
recollection.intervention: Synthesis of the alloy and characterization of its superconducting properties.
recollection.structure: Likely a multi-element crystalline or amorphous structure with high configurational entropy.
recollection.mechanism: Possible electron pairing mechanism influenced by the complex electronic and lattice interactions in the high-entropy alloy.
recollection.results: Quantitative results might include the critical temperature (Tc) for superconductivity, resistivity measurements, and magnetic susceptibility data.

score.note: The recollection gives only generic statements about synthesizing and characterizing a Tb-containing high-entropy alloy.
